payload.title: File:Laueropterus vitriolus (holotype, skull).png
payload.credit_html: "A new early monofenestratan pterosaur from the Mörnsheim Formation of southern Germany"
payload.description_html: The skull of the Laueropterus vitriolus holotype (LF 6268). Major skull elements of LF 6268. (A) Rostrum with the premaxilla-maxilla complex and teeth seen in right lateral view. (B) Skull roof seen in dorsal view with the left quadrate, jugal and quadratojugal in lateral view. Labels as in Fig. 1. Scale bars = 50 mm and 10 mm, respectively.
